extracted.intended_audience: prospective Ford Foundation Fellowship applicants (graduate students, postdocs, and early-career academics), mentors, and institutional administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Selection criteria used by the Ford Foundation Fellowships (administered by the National Academies) to evaluate applicants for support across stages of an academic career, focused on academic achievement, career commitment, future promise, and use of diversity in teaching and scholarship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrated superior academic achievement
rubrics_metrics.description: Support for individuals who demonstrated superior academic achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated as a primary qualification for fellowship recipients; no further scoring guidance on the page. Implies evaluation of transcripts, publications, awards, or other objective evidence of high academic performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to a career in teaching and research at the college or university level
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must have committed to a career in teaching and research at the college or university level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program favors candidates who clearly articulate and demonstrate a sustained commitment to academic careers (teaching + research). The page does not give detailed examples, but this likely includes statements of purpose, career plans, and prior teaching/research experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promise of future achievement as scholars and teachers
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants should have "shown promise of future achievement as scholars and teachers."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluators would look for indicators of future potential (e.g., research trajectory, letters of recommendation, teaching experience/statement). The page presents this as a distinct selection factor but provides no scoring rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of diversity as a resource for enriching the education of all students
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants should have "used diversity as a resource for enriching the education of all students."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This criterion emphasizes demonstrated practice or plans that leverage ethnic/racial or other forms of diversity to enhance pedagogy and student learning. Could be evidenced by teaching philosophy, curricular development, outreach, mentoring, or scholarship that integrates diversity as a pedagogical or scholarly asset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance program goals to increase faculty diversity and maximize educational benefits of diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellowship was "designed to increase the diversity of the nation's college and university faculties by increasing their ethnic and racial diversity, maximizing the educational benefits of diversity, and increasing the number of professors who use diversity as a resource for enriching the education of all students."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the program-level objective against which candidate fit is judged—applicants are evaluated not only on individual merit but also on their potential contribution to the program's stated aims of broadening faculty diversity and enhancing education through diversity. The page does not provide explicit weighting or scoring; it frames selection priorities.
